about: RLF Family Law works from Vesey Street and is the only firm in this ranking that publishes how it bills: invoices twice a month rather than once, so a client sees the account before the month turns. It names three attorneys with a rank beside each, and its site now answers at cadicny.com.

120 reviews at 4.8, collected in two years, which is the shortest history here. It explains eleven stages of a matrimonial case. It publishes no rate and no retainer figure, which leaves the twice-monthly invoice describing the rhythm of a bill whose size is not published.
